description: This file is a Yocto recipe fragment (included as a .inc file) defining how to build and install the IPv6 router advertisement daemon 'radvd'. It specifies metadata, dependencies, source URLs, installation steps, service configuration, and related scripts for integrating 'radvd' into an embedded Linux image.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Handles installation of radvd scripts, configuration, systemd service files, documentation, and default environment files, including path modifications and directory setup.

methods.name: pkg_postinst
methods.description: Post-installation script that updates volatile files if applicable.
